Company ceased development of CT-0508 and CT-0525, paused CT-1119 (clinical-stage activities not yet initiated; IND-stage), and paused preclinical CT-2401. No active P1/P2/P3 sponsored trials remain; in vivo macrophage engineering platform programs are preclinical/IND-pending.
